summary: Master advanced custody operations, T+1 settlement, corporate actions, and digital asset integration. Build resilient asset servicing workflows. Enroll today.
lede: Custody operations training helps asset servicing professionals manage complex settlement and corporate action workflows. It covers resolving settlement exceptions, processing voluntary and mandatory events, assessing sub-custodian networks, reconciling cash and stock, and transitioning messaging from SWIFT MT to ISO 20022 in day-to-day operations.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for intermediate to advanced asset servicing professionals who must execute, manage, or oversee complex custody workflows in a highly regulated, time-sensitive environment.
modules: Global Custody Architecture and Network Management
Cash Management, FX, and Income Collection
Digital Assets and the Future of Custody
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic trade lifecycles, securities markets, and standard SWIFT messaging. No coding or programming experience is required.
